## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 252 captures during January 2021. This represents the activity submitted for the reporting month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading performance. Activity should continue to be monitored through routine reporting, with any operational matters noted as they arise.

## Image quality

There were 12 ungradable image sets. The ungradable rate was 4.8 per cent. This measure should be reviewed alongside local equipment and workflow information to identify any recurring issues that may affect the usability of captured images. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be followed up through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 41 referable results. The median wait from photograph to grade was 1 day. These results should be considered with the image-quality findings when reviewing the service’s performance for January 2021. Maintaining accurate recording of captures, ungradable images, referable results and grading lag will support ongoing oversight at West Gate Eye Clinic.
